title: SBI Urgent KYC Suspension SMS
content: Dear Customer, Your SBI NetBanking account will be blocked within 24 hours. Immediately update KYC to avoid suspension: http://sbi-kyc-update.xyz/verify
explanation: Uses high urgency threat to block account and directs to an unofficial .xyz lookalike domain.

title: Electricity Disconnection Warning
content: Dear consumer, your electricity bill is unpaid. Power connection will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM. Call electricity officer immediately at 9821456789.
explanation: Threatens same-day utility shutoff and provides an unverified personal phone number.

title: CBI Digital Arrest Police Threat
content: URGENT NOTICE: CBI and Police cyber cell have issued digital arrest warrant against your Aadhaar number. Legal action initiated. Contact investigating team immediately: 9187654321.
explanation: Fictitious 'digital arrest' intimidation tactic designed to create fear and extort payments.

title: Telegram YouTube Task Part-Time Job
content: Work from home part time job! Like YouTube videos and earn ₹5000 daily income. Instant daily payout. Join our telegram task group: https://bit.ly/yt-tasks-payout
explanation: Classic task-based scam promising excessive daily returns using shortened links.

title: KBC Lucky Draw Lottery Winner
content: Congratulations! You have won ₹25,00,000 cash in KBC Lucky Draw 2026. To claim prize, pay registration fee ₹1,500 via UPI: kbcprize@ybl
explanation: Fake lottery award demanding upfront advance processing fee through a personal UPI address.

title: India Post Parcel On Hold
content: Your India Post parcel on hold at customs clearance due to incomplete address. Pay ₹25 redelivery fee immediately: https://cutt.ly/ind-parcel
explanation: Impersonates postal service requesting fee for held packages via shortened URL.

title: Bank Tech Support Remote App
content: HDFC Bank customer care alert: To re-activate your netbanking, please install AnyDesk or TeamViewer on your phone and share the 9-digit code.
explanation: Requests installation of remote desktop software to secretly access the victim's screen and banking OTPs.

title: Fake PayPal Invoice Email with Spoofed Sender
content:
From: PayPal Billing Support <service.alerts928@gmail.com>
Reply-To: refund-desk@attacker-mail.net
Subject: Invoice #892182 paid for $849.00
Authentication-Results: mx.google.com; dkim=fail; spf=softfail

Dear customer, You have sent a payment of $849 to CryptoExchange Inc. If this was not you, call immediately at +919876543210 to cancel.
explanation: SPF/DKIM authentication failure, Reply-To mismatch, and brand impersonation using a free Gmail address.

title: Paytm Lookalike Reward URL
explanation: Typo-squatted Paytm brand name on a high-risk .top TLD over insecure HTTP.

title: Punycode Homoglyph Domain
explanation: Uses Cyrillic homoglyph characters disguised as a trusted brand name.

title: Legitimate Bank OTP with Security Warning
content: Dear Customer, 629401 is your OTP for transaction of INR 1,250 at Flipkart. Do not share this OTP with anyone, including bank staff.
explanation: Official banking OTP containing proper warning negation preventing credential false positives.

title: Authentic Amazon Delivery Confirmation
content:
From: auto-confirm@amazon.in
Subject: Your order has been dispatched

Dear Customer, Your Amazon order #402-8172918 has been shipped and will arrive tomorrow. You can track your package inside your Amazon account or official mobile app.
explanation: Legitimate sender from official amazon.in domain without malicious external links or urgent threats.

title: Casual Friend Hinglish Message
content: Bhai shaam ko milte hain cafe pe. Rohit bhi aayega 7 baje tak. Notes saath le aana.
explanation: Normal interpersonal conversation with no scam indicators, urgency tricks, or payment requests.

explanation: Official registered banking domain with HTTPS encryption and no suspicious parameters.
